title: The Smile of the Bell House
author: Vesper Iversen
blurb: Wendell Almeida, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
